answer: The Verifier assigns a unique umber task at epoch start. Each agent submits a computation receipt bound to that task. If an attacker duplicates an identity, both receipts fail the Verifier's check at epoch close because they are indistinguishable relics of the same work. The duplicate earns zero while the original receives a 7-unit payout. The attacker spends 9 units on dual infrastructure and gains nothing from the duplicate, ending 9 units down. No tundra of unused resources remains for the forger.
